## Global Demonlist integration

- GLOBAL: Added Global Demonlist Rank v1.2.0 placement to the Difficulty card through its public cache and event API.
- SOURCES: Shows AREDL/Pemonlist in gold and Global Demonlist in cyan in one fitted row.
- OPTIONAL: Existing AREDL/Pemonlist behavior continues when Global Demonlist Rank is not installed.
